items.title: Asymmetric Numeral Systems
items.summary: ANS encodes a probability model through reversible updates of one integer state, approaching arithmetic-coding efficiency with fast table or arithmetic implementations.

items.title: Minute-scale red phosphorescence in carbon nanodots
items.summary: Engineered carbon nanodots reach a roughly 353-second phosphorescence lifetime and over 4000 seconds of persistence through fast and slow triplet-state channels.

items.summary: Drapatyi replaces Syrskyi after protests and reform conflict; Greece is blocking an EU sanctions package to protect specialized LNG shipping interests.

items.title: Sub-keV fusion enhancement is not net-energy cold fusion
items.summary: Fusion yields in deuterium-loaded metal hydrides plateau below 2 keV and strongly exceed unscreened expectations, but the absolute rates and full-system energy balance remain the relevant constraints.

items.title: Marx on necessity, associated production and free time
items.summary: The realm of freedom begins beyond labour imposed by necessity; collective regulation and reduction of necessary labour are both required.

items.title: Adam Smith and Benjamin Constant on agency and modern liberty
items.summary: Smith warns that social agents have motions of their own; Constant argues that modern political freedom must protect individual independence rather than demand total civic absorption.

items.title: Smalt pigment degradation
items.summary: Potassium leaching from cobalt-containing glass changes cobalt coordination and can erase the blue colour of smalt in old oil paintings.

items.title: Braess's paradox
items.summary: Adding a zero-cost link to a congested network creates a worse selfish-routing equilibrium, raising every driver's travel time from 65 to 80 minutes.
